observations.title: GlitchCore role and integration boundary
observations.player_action: Use the consuming mod's interface or feature; this component's own installation is not a survival objective.
observations.outcome: Abstracts mod-loader services and shared utilities for Glitchfiend consumers such as Serene Seasons; each consumer owns its world and seasonal behavior.
conditions: Exact installed artifact metadata was inspected; current author pages can cover newer versions.
No runtime behavior or benchmark was verified; do not change installed configuration from these research notes.
observations.review_note: Installed static role is corroborated by the artifact/resource/SHA256 attached to the source. Public URL identifies the upstream project, not a claim that a missing web guide was read. Multiple packaged versions remain loader-resolution candidates: 0.0.1.1
